exact_emitter_program:
import ast,base64,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
source=Path('scripts/cloud_cdr_v59_binding_rc.py')
assert source.is_file() and not source.is_symlink()
raw=source.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='647af19c78158045739b2589d61a2962bbff69e230b593ccb33019550edbd709'
nodes=[n for n in ast.parse(raw.decode()).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='emit']
assert len(nodes)==1
scope=dict(base64=base64,hashlib=hashlib,json=json)
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),str(source),'exec'),scope)
folder=Path('hw/soc/out/cdr-tail-controls')
assert not folder.is_symlink()
assert not folder.exists() or folder.is_dir()
names=('imports','source','topology','physical','runtime','publication')
assert len(names)==len(set(names))==6
assert {p.name for p in folder.glob('*.json')} <= {name+'.json' for name in names}
emitted=[];missing=[]
for name in names:
    path=folder/(name+'.json')
    assert not path.is_symlink(),str(path)
    if not path.exists():
        missing.append(path.name)
        continue
    assert path.is_file(),str(path)
    scope['emit'](path,'CDR_TAIL_CONTROL_'+name.upper())
    emitted.append(dict(name=path.name,bytes=path.stat().st_size,sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
print('CDR_TAIL_CONTROL_FILE_CENSUS '+json.dumps(dict(emitted=emitted,missing=missing,missing_files_created=False),sort_keys=True),flush=True)
